subject: A Tamil woman flower seller arranging fresh jasmine and orange marigold garlands for the Chithirai festival. She wears a simple traditional cotton sari. Her expressions and movements are natural and unposed.

setting.place: East Masi Street near the eastern entrance of Meenakshi Amman Temple, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.

lighting: Soft natural morning sunlight, gentle shadows and realistic highlights.

camera.shot: Wide establishing shot transitioning into a medium shot of the flower seller.
camera.camera_move: Slow cinematic dolly-in with stable movement

style: Photorealistic cinematic documentary video, authentic Tamil street atmosphere, realistic human movements and culturally accurate Madurai surroundings.

motion.subject_motion: The flower seller gently picks up fresh jasmine flowers, separates them, and carefully arranges them into a garland using both hands. She briefly looks at her work and continues arranging flowers.
motion.environment_motion: Flower garlands sway gently in the morning breeze. A few pedestrians walk naturally in the distant background. Subtle movement of people and street activity creates an authentic Madurai atmosphere.
motion.camera_move: Begin with a wide establishing view of the temple street. Slowly dolly towards the flower seller, transitioning into a medium shot that captures her hands arranging jasmine flowers.

timeline.action: Establish the Madurai temple street, showing the Meenakshi Amman Temple gopuram and morning atmosphere.
Camera slowly approaches the flower seller arranging jasmine and marigold garlands.
Show her hands carefully picking and arranging fresh jasmine flowers into a garland.
Camera settles into a closer composition of the flower arrangement while the seller continues working naturally.

motion.continuity: Maintain consistent facial features, clothing, flower arrangement, temple architecture, lighting and background throughout the entire video.

audio.ambience: Natural Madurai street ambience, distant temple bells, subtle pedestrian activity and gentle morning sounds.
